definition: Retrieving all images or video frames of a queried person from a large collection — search over person embeddings.
details: Retrieving all images or video frames of a queried person from a large collection — search over person embeddings.

explainer.lead: Person retrieval is retrieving all images or video frames of a queried person from a large collection, done as search over person embeddings. It matters for finding a specific person across large visual archives.

tiers.eli5: You give the system a picture of someone, and it pulls out every photo or video frame in a big library that shows that same person.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers implement it as search over person embeddings to return all matching images or frames for a query person from a large collection.
tiers.paperLevel: Retrieving all images or video frames of a queried person from a large collection; performed as search over person embeddings.

explainer.example: Given a query image of a person, the system searches a large collection of frames by embedding similarity and returns every frame containing that person.
